hot take: subscribing to more content does not make you more informed


most builders got a stack of like 67 subscriptions for different things

one newsletter for ai news
another for market trends
a podcast for startup advice
etc... i feel like you're picking up what i'm putting down

the problem isn’t a lack of information

it’s that the useful information is scattered across ten different places, leaving you to manually connect the dots between meetings, coffee refills, and the occasional existential crisis

->cue Nura AI

instead of asking builders to keep adding subscriptions, platforms, and workflows, Nura AI brings the information they need into one all-in-one experience

the goal isn’t to consume more

it’s to make better decisions faster—with fewer tabs, less noise, and ideally, fewer “read later” lists

because the best intelligence platform isn’t the one that gives you the most information

it’s the one that helps you know what actually deserves your attention

in the end better information > more information

introverts in #business are not talked about enough


i used to be so so introverted to the point where in elementary and some of middle school i wouldn't even talk to people unless they talked to me first or if i needed something

it was bad but thank God i started working a service job early at 15 which forced me to develop my social skills

from front desk to swim instructor to now pool manager i HAD to talk to people

fast forward to today i can coffee chat one on one with complete strangers—might not seem like much but to me it's a major milestone

12 year old me would have never thought this day would come

im nowhere close to where I wanna be

still and always will be working on it

remember sometimes you just need something to force you out of your comfort zone because that's the biggest growth catalyst


if you're an introvert in business lets connect fr comment or send me a dm :)
